podcast.title: High School Band
podcast.body: This band consisted of Gord Sinclair and Robbie Baker, who were a couple of grades ahead of Gord Downie at Kingston Collegiate Vocational High. They grew up across the street from each other. "A couple of grades ahead of him were some guys in the band called The Rodents."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Local Punk Outfit
podcast.body: This was a local punk band that Gord Downie encountered, and it notably included Rob Baker and Gord Sinclair, who lived across the street from each other. Despite Gord Downie being a couple of grades behind Baker and Sinclair in school, they expressed a desire for him to join their group at some point. "Eventually he ran into another local band, a punk outfit called Rick and the Rodent S."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
